tests.title: Safety, Equality & Regulatory Awareness — Mock Test 1

questions.question: Refusing to carry a passenger because of their religion would breach which UK law?
questions.explanation: The Equality Act 2010 prohibits discrimination on protected characteristics.

questions.question: Which is a protected characteristic under the Equality Act?
questions.explanation: Race is one of nine protected characteristics.

questions.question: If a wheelchair user books a suitable vehicle, the driver should:
options: Provide reasonable assistance at no extra fare
questions.explanation: Drivers must not charge more for disabled passengers and should provide reasonable assistance.

questions.question: Discrimination 'because someone is associated with' a disabled person is called:
questions.explanation: Discrimination by association is unlawful under the Equality Act 2010.

questions.question: Which body regulates licensed taxi and PHV drivers in London?
questions.explanation: Transport for London regulates the trade in Greater London.

questions.question: A passenger asks you to drive over the speed limit to make their flight. You should:
questions.explanation: Drivers must always obey the law and put safety first.

questions.question: Reasonable adjustments for disabled passengers are:
questions.explanation: Service providers, including PHV drivers, must make reasonable adjustments.

questions.question: If you witness another driver harassing a passenger, you should:
options: Report it to your operator and TfL
questions.explanation: Concerns must be reported through proper channels.
